'''John Charles Mills''' (born 28 November 1941) is an Australian politician who represented [[Electoral district of Wallsend|Wallsend]] in the [[New South Wales Legislative Assembly]] for the [[Australian Labor Party (New South Wales Branch)|Labor Party]] from 1988 to 2007.

Mills was awarded a [[Bachelor of Science]] (Hons), and a [[Master of Science]]. He was a previously an industrial chemist with [[BHP]]. He is married with two children. He represented [[Electoral district of Wallsend|Wallsend]] for the [[Australian Labor Party (New South Wales Branch)|Labor Party]] from 1988 to 2007.<ref>{{Cite NSW Parliament |name=Mr John Charles Mills (1941– ) |former=Yes |access-date=30 April 2019 |id=1983}}</ref>
